text:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick sync 1: SI onboarding pilot next week. Need to confirm joint announcement plan with HW partner and marketplace listing demo.
Owen (SI Program): Roster's 10 SIs. Can we squeeze a short certification gate after the hands-on labs? 30m pass/fail?
Sofia (Training Ops): 30m practical exam + 10m review is doable. Need proctors and the exam VM snapshot.
Ben (Marketplace): I'll demo the supplier onboarding flow. Want to include a step for co-branded listing assets. HW partner asked about asset approval SLA.
Maya (Partnerships): HW partner (SkyFoundry) wants a 48h review window for co-branded images before public listing. That should be in the playbook.
HW-bot: Note: SkyFoundry provided device firmware images at https://partners.skyfoundry/static/fw-2026-02.zip (sha256: abc123...).
Owen (SI Program): Action items: Owen -> upload roster; Sofia -> create exam VM + rubric; Ben -> prepare demo slides and co-branding checklist; Maya -> confirm SkyFoundry SLA and announcement date.
Sofia (Training Ops): I'll create the README in the VM with the scoring rubric. Proctors: need 1 per 5 candidates.
legal-bot: Reminder: co-brand materials require partner sign-off and DPA addendum for EU listings. Legal will fast-track once we get partner contact.
Maya (Partnerships): Partner contact: helen@skyfoundry.com. I'll loop legal and ask for the asset approval template.
Ben (Marketplace): Demo snippet for the playbook (sandbox):
```bash
curl -X POST https://sandbox.redwood/marketplace/suppliers \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBOX_KEY" \
  -F "name=SkyFoundry" \
  -F "asset=@co-branded.png" \
  -F "region=eu"
```
Owen (SI Program): If announcement is co-marketed, we need a short runbook for joint social posts + who approves copy. Add to playbook.
Sofia (Training Ops): Uploaded trainer checklist and exam rubric to the cohort page. lms-bot will auto-send consent forms.
lms-bot: Consent emails queued for 10 SIs. Template: https://intranet.redwood/lms/si-consent-v2
Maya (Partnerships): If SkyFoundry can't sign SLA in time, fallback is internal demo assets with "partner preview" wording. Keep me posted.
Owen (SI Program): Roster uploaded. Two SIs requested hardware passthrough; @HW-bot can you confirm tenant limits?
HW-bot: Tenant quota check: available passthrough slots = 3 for next week window.
Maya (Partnerships): Great. Closing loop: I'll post final checklist here tomorrow morning. Thanks all :tada:
